fields.description: Issue includes political commentary urging a “wet” vote on repeal and local option in Dade County, discussion of Miami Beach politics and alleged gangster influence, and coverage of crime and investigations including the assassination of Leo Bornstein and related public reaction. Also contains local civic and tax debates (homestead exemption and sales tax), entertainment and nightlife items, radio schedules, sports and racing tips/advertisements, and community letters and notices.
